selection_disclosure: The training and held-out diagrams were selected after visual inspection of the full-corpus atlas. The numerical test is frozen before reading its clean-source output, but the experiment is a pilot and cannot by itself establish an allegorical system.

primary_rule.training_selection: Choose the pairing with the minimum sum of within-pair Euclidean distances after feature-wise z-scoring across the four sectors of f57v.
primary_rule.transfer_statistic: Apply the selected pairing without rotating or relabelling any held-out page. Sum its pairing score over all held-out diagrams.
primary_rule.null: Independently permute the pairing identity on each held-out diagram; enumerate all 3^4 assignments.
primary_rule.pass: At least 3 of 4 held-out diagrams prefer the frozen training pairing and the exact lower-tail permutation p-value is < 0.05.
primary_rule.fail: Fewer than 3 held-out preferences, p >= 0.05, or page-specific rotation/relabeling is required.

sensitivity_grid.interpretation: Sensitivity cannot rescue a failed primary result; it only measures dependence on crop geometry.

diagrams.observable_basis: Four heads around the central flower-like mark.
Four small peripheral figures around a central flower-like form.
Four dominant lobes around a central circular wheel.
Four surrounding lobed structures around a central solar face.
Four cardinal rosettes around the central rosette.
